title: The Time Clock User system role cannot be edited (lock icon, eye only)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Time Clock User row.
  2. Look at the Actions column.
  3. Click the eye icon.
custom_expected:
There is no pencil icon; only the eye icon.

A read-only Permission Summary opens for Time Clock User.
evidence: UI: on the Roles list the Time Clock User row shows a lock and only the eye icon — no pencil; the eye opens the read-only Permission Summary. Same /edit-URL FE-gap note as C26346.
